header_summary:
The Time-Shifted Proof of Work (TSPOW) is a transformative proposal aimed at enhancing the Bitcoin Proof of Work model by addressing stability, security, and decentralization. It proposes a novel block-time variance system that decouples mining warrants from block authorship, thereby stabilizing block production times and ensuring fairer mining outcomes. Security improvements include mechanisms to discourage selfish-mining through expiring warrants and transparent block author selection processes. The proposal, still in the informational stage, includes a detailed specification and security analysis available on GitHub ([Full spec and analysis](https://github.com/corepool/timeshiftpow)).

Jonas Nick and Mikhail Kudinov have introduced SHRINCS, a semi-stateful hash-based signature scheme that improves on compactness and verification speeds, aligning with post-quantum security standards. Although still in its prototype phase and requiring extensive review, SHRINCS promises enhanced performance and interoperability for blockchain applications. The community is invited to contribute to its development through feedback and discussions on its design and security features ([SHRINCS.md](https://github.com/SHRINCS/shrincs-bip/blob/main/SHRINCS.md)).

In addressing blockchain mining dynamics, a significant update on testnet5 proposes disabling the min-difficulty rule to counteract the strategic manipulation of block times by CPU and ASIC miners. This change aims to stabilize the testnet environment and prevent mining conflicts that compromise network performance. Details of this proposed update can be reviewed in the linked GitHub pull request ([this pull request](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35861)).

recent_posts.title: Draft BIP for discussion: Time-Shifted Proof of Work (TSPOW) — an informational consensus-design proposal
recent_posts.summary:
- TSPOW proposes stabilizing block-time variance by separating mining warrants from block authorship.
- It counters selfish-mining by making withholding proofs economically disadvantageous and enhancing transparency.
- The proposal aims to increase decentralization by changing block authorship criteria to favor fairer miner opportunities.

recent_posts.title: SHRINCS: an efficient hash-based signature scheme for Bitcoin (first draft)
recent_posts.summary:
- The SHRINCS Working Group has drafted a new cryptographic Bitcoin proposal.
- This prototype presents a semi-stateful hash-based signature scheme requiring further review.
- Pros include compact keys and fast verification; cons involve demanding computational needs.

recent_posts.title: Disabling min-difficulty blocks on testnet4
recent_posts.summary:
- Proposed changes on testnet5 aim to disable the min-difficulty rule.
- CPU and ASIC miners manipulate timestamps to influence mining difficulty.
- Stability issues in testnet4 prompt the move to simplify rules in testnet5.

recent_posts.title: Silent Payments coinbase
recent_posts.summary:
- The implementation of BIP34 encodes block height, using significant transaction data space.
- Current BIP34 encoding requires four bytes, potentially increasing to five in future.
- Remaining space for extranonce in coinbase transactions may become constrained.

recent_posts.title: Disclosure: Crashing CLN with a flood of pings
recent_posts.summary:
- A critical DoS vulnerability was discovered in Core Lightning's node implementation.
- The vulnerability involves unbounded memory use due to specific message handling.
- A fix, involving modified message handling, has been successfully implemented.

active_posts.title: A Post-Quantum Path for BIP 324
active_posts.summary:
- BIP 324 is debated for upgrading to resist quantum computing threats.
- Hybrid and pure post-quantum KEMs are potential solutions to enhance encryption.
- Implementation requires careful network compatibility and efficiency considerations.

active_posts.title: post-quantum: solution ideas to "tripwire"game-theory issues + a certificate-based rescue protocol
active_posts.summary: - Solutions for blockchain's game-theory issues include a new UTXO Model Space tactic.  - Another method uses group signatures and a Merkle tree to enhance proof of work.  - Certificates on Bitcoin's blockchain may protect EC coin owners against quantum threats.

active_posts.title: DropKick ⚽️ - A minimal commit/reveal PQ rescue protocol
active_posts.summary:
- DropKick aids Bitcoin users by enabling asset transfer to PQ-secure wallets using blockchain commitments.
- It uses a two-step process with hidden commitments and SPV-style proofs for coin spending.
- The protocol supports various one-way functions and allows third-party aggregators to manage PQ commitments.

active_posts.title: PQC output type discussion
active_posts.summary: - The email details strategies to enhance Bitcoin's defense against quantum threats using PQC.  - It proposes a P2TRv2 output type for emergency PQC and discusses two-phase implementation plans.  - The discussion also evaluates ECC disabling timing and mechanisms for community decisions.

active_posts.title: Segwit commitment to post-quantum witness data?
active_posts.summary:
- Enhancing blockchain for post-quantum cryptography requires adjustments like larger block sizes.
- Implementing changes could complicate transactions, requiring new identifiers and network updates.
- An alternative solution places post-quantum data within existing segwit areas, mitigating some complexities.

active_posts.title: Pragmatic definition of consensus for light clients
active_posts.summary: - Economic actors guide blockchain consensus by valuing chains based on Proof of Work.  - Utreexo boosts security by verifying unspent transaction outputs in blockchain operations.  - Pragmatic light-client protocol changes enhance security and decision-making in fork scenarios.

today_in_history_posts.title: Reconciling the off-chain and on-chain models with eltoo
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Richard's eltoo proof-of-concept on signet has encouraged Christian to discuss its architecture.
- Eltoo's clean separation allows easier building of advanced functionalities, reducing complexity.
- Christian envisions using transactions for off-chain negotiations as advantageous, enhancing flexibility.

today_in_history_posts.title: Reconciling the off-chain and on-chain models with eltoo
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Richard's proof-of-concept of eltoo on signet enhances system-building discussions.
- Eltoo ensures confirmed on-chain state and simplifies complex functionalities beyond HTLCs.
- The system uses transactions for off-chain negotiations, incorporating tools like miniscript and hardware wallets.

today_in_history_posts.title: Thoughts on scaling and consensus changes (2023)
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Bitcoin aims to support 1 billion users via 50,000 off-chain "bitcoin banks."- These entities will connect, balancing transaction cost and security, enhancing liquidity.
- A hybrid system integrating Layer 2 innovations ensures Bitcoin's scalability and integrity.
